entradas.text: “President Rayne. Welcome to Perla.”
“Thank you. It's good to be here, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you. It's good to be here, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Have a seat.”
“I hear a lot about your successes, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “I hear a lot about your successes, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: He smiled and left the room.
“I hope you had a nice trip.”
“Thank you, Mr. Rayne. That is very kind of you.”
“You owe me a teapot.”
I smelled the strong odor of alcohol.
On his way to the door, he suddenly turned around.
“Before I forget.”
“Have you been drinking?”
entradas.menu: “Have you been drinking?”

entradas.text: I didn't say anything.
entradas.menu: Don't say anything.

entradas.text: “Thank you for your visit.”
“A couple of glasses of the finest Lespian wine is the best way to start any meeting.”
“I would recommend you not to badmouth Colonel Soll.”
entradas.menu: “I would recommend you not to badmouth Colonel Soll.”

entradas.text: “Would you like some?”
“No, thank you.”
entradas.menu: “No, thank you.”

entradas.text: “I'm afraid I have to leave now to attend to other matters.”
“Since you asked, why not?”
entradas.menu: “Since you asked, why not?”

entradas.text: He looked at the clock.
“You are speaking to a President. Where is your professionalism?”
entradas.menu: “You are speaking to a President. Where is your professionalism?”

entradas.text: “Let's begin then.”
He cleared his throat.
“Very well.”
He gestured to the assistants.
“Two glasses.”
“And?”
entradas.menu: “And?”

entradas.text: They came back very fast. They must've been used to this. We took a sip.
“Ah. Nothing like it.”
He turned around with a smile and opened his arms.
“I am overjoyed. This is a start to bring our countries closer than ever before.”
“So, you are here for the trade deal.”
“What was it about again? Can you remind me?”
“I want the only thing that anyone could possibly ever want out of Wehlen.”
“Don't you worry about my professionalism.”
“Before you make your final decision, let me tell you about my offer.”
“Mr. Alvarez. Are you making fun of me right now?”
entradas.menu: “Mr. Alvarez. Are you making fun of me right now?”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish fishing output in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish fishing output in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “My apologies. I never took you for a Sollist.”
“I am doing exactly that right now.”
“We want to provide Sordish wheat in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish wheat in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish coal in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish coal in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “We want to provide Sordish tungsten in return for Lespian capital.”
entradas.menu: “We want to provide Sordish tungsten in return for Lespian capital.”

entradas.text: “Not every hard decision is right, Mr. Rayne.”
“No. Absolutely not.”
“I have just been very busy lately.”
“My favorite phrase in this world. 'I accept.'.”
“I had to make a hard decision, and this is the result of it.”
entradas.menu: “I had to make a hard decision, and this is the result of it.”

entradas.text: “You know...being the Prime Minister makes you pretty busy.”
“Ah. Yes. Right.”
“Take care of your own country's issues first, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Take care of your own country's issues first, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Sorry. I have just been very busy lately.”
“Not to mention the humanitarian implications. We had to do our duty and send aid to those who were displaced as a result.”
“We Eastern Merkopans should stand together.”
“So, I don't have any issues with this deal.”
“I will sign the executive order.”
“Except there is one problem.”
“You know...being the Prime Minister makes you pretty busy.”
He pulled out a few documents from his briefcase and started inspecting them.
“Wehlen.”
He smirked.
“Your decision to defend the border while Smolak committed war crimes diverted all those refugees here.”
“Now we have a full-blown refugee crisis in Lespia.”
“Which unfortunately means that the price has gone up, Mr. Rayne.”
“Your decision to join Smolak in his attack against the unfortunate Bludish population compromised a lot of the Lespian assets in the area.”
“This has negatively affected Lespia. Our economy was indirectly hit due to the destruction of manufacturing sites. In particular the oil refineries.”
“No. The price will stay the same or there won't be any deal.”
entradas.menu: “No. The price will stay the same or there won't be any deal.”

entradas.text: “Tell me what you want, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Tell me what you want, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: We shook hands.
“Makes sense. I knew this was coming. So what is on the new price tag?”
entradas.menu: “Makes sense. I knew this was coming. So what is on the new price tag?”

entradas.text: “It is your choice.”
“Just like it was your choice to leave Bludish people alone to fend for themselves.”
“Reminds me of Soll in many ways. What was it? Ah yes. The Soll Dam Incident.”
“Good intuition.”
“The only thing that anyone could possibly ever want out of Wehlen.”
“I want their oil.”
“And how are you planning to get that?”
entradas.menu: “And how are you planning to get that?”

entradas.text: “I'm listening.”
entradas.menu: “I'm listening.”

entradas.text: “A lot of oil from Wehlen is passing through Sordland.”
“I think this deal will contribute nicely to the relationship between Lespia and Sordland.”
“And Sordish Petroleum owns most of the oil trade in Sordland.”
“Excellent.”
“Do you see where I am going with that?”
“Yes, I do.”
entradas.menu: “Yes, I do.”

entradas.text: “Enlighten me.”
entradas.menu: “Enlighten me.”

entradas.text: “You really are a shrewd man, Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “You really are a shrewd man, Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “I want you to sell me Sordish Petroleum or the deal is off.”
“I wish I could say the same about you.”
“Don't take my kindness for granted.”
entradas.menu: “Don't take my kindness for granted.”

entradas.text: “What the hell does that mean?”
entradas.menu: “What the hell does that mean?”

entradas.text: “No need to argue, right? We have just met.”
entradas.menu: “No need to argue, right? We have just met.”

entradas.text: “Ah, Mr. Rayne. You know what you have done.”
“Your actions speak for themselves. It almost seems like you are on a mission to ideologically oppose us.”
“And don't take my straightforwardness for granted, Mr. Rayne.”
“Exactly. We don't need to waste any time.”
“By us, I mean Lespia and ATO.”
“Despite a lack of ideological alignments.”
“When did ideology ever stop deals from happening?”
entradas.menu: “When did ideology ever stop deals from happening?”

entradas.text: “That is excellent news.”
entradas.menu: “That is excellent news.”

entradas.text: “Very good. We are done then.”
entradas.menu: “Very good. We are done then.”

entradas.text: “Yes. We are done.”
“I could count at least a few dozen instances, but let's not go into that.”
“I'm glad we are on the same page.”
“I'm glad this was quick. The less time I spend here, the better.”
entradas.menu: “I'm glad this was quick. The less time I spend here, the better.”

entradas.text: “Perhaps we could advance this deal. What are your thoughts about an alliance?”
entradas.menu: “Perhaps we could advance this deal. What are your thoughts about an alliance?”

entradas.text: “Thank you for having me.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for having me.”

entradas.text: “Mr. Rayne, Mr. Rayne, Mr. Rayne.”
“I don't think so.”
“You should be glad that I am a lenient man. That's the only reason we were able to achieve a deal today.”
“I wouldn't push it if I were you.”
“Have a good day, Mr. Rayne.”
“If I were you I would reconsider my decision on who my friends and foes are.”
“I thought the Prime Minister of Lespia would have at least some amount of social aptitude.”
entradas.menu: “I thought the Prime Minister of Lespia would have at least some amount of social aptitude.”

entradas.text: “I can assure you, I do, Mr. Rayne.”
“And it is reserved only for my friends.”
On his way to the door, he suddenly turned around.
“Before I forget.”
“You owe me a teapot.”
He left the room and an assistant arrived to escort me.
“There is no way I can do that.”
entradas.menu: “There is no way I can do that.”

entradas.text: “Wait. Fine. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Wait. Fine. I accept.” [-1 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “Then thank you for coming this far to visit Perla.”
He got up and started making his way to the door.
“Very well. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I accept.” [-1 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “I will take that as a compliment.”
I let him go without saying anything.
entradas.menu: Let him go.

entradas.text: “Shrewd but not investigative enough. The Energy Protection Act doesn't allow such a transaction.”
entradas.menu: “Shrewd but not investigative enough. The Energy Protection Act doesn't allow such a transaction.”

entradas.text: “Our energy protection laws don't allow such actions. I can't comply Mr. Alvarez.”
entradas.menu: “Our energy protection laws don't allow such actions. I can't comply Mr. Alvarez.”

entradas.text: “Goodbye.”
entradas.menu: “Goodbye.”

entradas.text: “Very well. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I accept.”

entradas.text: “Very well. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. I accept.”
